text:
The building the The Palace, to the right was a bar I was in, there was an explosion so I ran and someone had there throat bleeding so I took off my t-shirt and wrapped it around real tight. I don't know if he lived or died. there was nothing but wounded people all over the street. There was a bomb of some kind. 
Went in to get some to eat and beer.
The street running parallel to the side is Tudo street and i used to hang out in a bar called The Papallon (which means butterfly in french). That was the bar special forces hang out and I would meet Lowry there if he was off duty and in town. Lowry usually worked at Body Jab 42 Nui Ba Den. 

It was very common to have 3 special forces guys land in a helicopter in the afternoon and in the middle of the night they were gone.

When tet happened when I was there I was up in the mountain.
